findings.evidence: grep for `hadronicMethod_eq_ofTransfer` and `ofTransfer_x_eq_Q2_div` returns only the definition at AccessMethods.lean:188 and `electronMethod_eq_ofTransfer` at :213; `ofTransfer_x_eq_Q2_div` has no call site in the repo.
findings.fix: Add `hadronicMethod_eq_ofTransfer` and derive `hadronicMethod_x_eq_Q2_div` (and `electronMethod_x_eq_Q2_div`) from `ofTransfer_x_eq_Q2_div`, so all four methods carry the same characteristic form.
findings.issue: `hadronicMethod` is defined as `.ofTransfer g k p (pX - p)` but has no `hadronicMethod_eq_ofTransfer`, while `electronMethod_eq_ofTransfer` exists (line 213). Consequently the generic `ofTransfer_x_eq_Q2_div` (line 188) is unusable for the hadronic method without unfolding the def, and the `x = Q²/(2 (p·k) y)` form stated for `sigmaMethod` (242) and `mixedMethod` (248) has no hadronic counterpart.

findings.evidence: grep for `shiftXQ2_toReconstructed|shiftXY_toReconstructed` returns nothing; `toReconstructedInvariants` occurs only in the def (AccessMethods.lean:299) and in Radiative.lean proof steps.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem shiftXQ2_toReconstructedInvariants (t : TrueInvariants) : t.toReconstructedInvariants.shiftXQ2 t = 0` and the `shiftXY` analogue (immediate from `shiftXQ2_eq_zero_iff`).
findings.issue: `TrueInvariants.toReconstructedInvariants` has no lemma relating it to the shift maps. The Born-limit theorems are stated as `method = (trueInvariants …).toReconstructedInvariants` (Radiative.lean:298, 312, 319, 338) while every radiative result is stated as `shiftXQ2 … = 0` / `shiftXY … ≠ 0`; a consumer holding a Born-limit equation has no lemma to conclude the shift vanishes.

findings.evidence: roadmap/EpsilonEridaniRoadmaps/RadiativeCorrections/README.md:478-482 defines `trueMomentumTransfer`; grep for `trueMomentumTransfer` in EpsilonEridani/ returns nothing.
findings.fix: Add `RadiativeEvent.trueMomentumTransfer : V := e.pX - e.p` with a `@[simp]` defining lemma and `hardKinematics_q`-style restatement, and state the `trueInvariants_*_eq` lemmas against it.
findings.issue: Roadmap 1.1 names `trueMomentumTransfer` (`q_true = p_X - P`) as an explicit definition of the milestone this PR targets; it is not exposed. `e.pX - e.p` is spelled out raw in `trueInvariants_Q2_eq`, `trueInvariants_x_eq`, `trueInvariants_y_eq` and the collinear lemmas, and the only accessor `(e.hardKinematics l).q` requires supplying an `EmissionLine` the quantity does not depend on.

findings.fix: Use plain `public section`, as the sibling kinematics modules do.
findings.issue: `@[expose] public section` exposes every body in the new module, although no consumer needs to unfold: `leptonIn`/`leptonOut` have `(rfl)` simp lemmas (145-154) and `hardKinematics`/`trueInvariants` carry `@[simps]`. Exposed bodies let downstream proofs depend on the defeq `electronMethod ≡ ofTransfer` instead of the stated lemmas.

summary: The covariant-method surface is incomplete: the hadronic method lacks the ofTransfer restatement its three siblings have, nothing links the `= toReconstructedInvariants` Born-limit form to the `shift = 0` form, and the roadmap-named `trueMomentumTransfer` is unexposed. The new module also exposes bodies it does not need to.
